thread:
elaine: kicking off v2.23 rollout. plan: gated slowstart for feature flag `rec-ux-v2` (default OFF). start 1% -> incremental 3% steps every 7m up to 25%, hold 45m, then 100% in quiet window. change window 02:30-03:30 UTC. pin model during initial ramp.

 deploy-bot: [deploy] v2.23 triggered on prod-cluster-5. canary cohort = cohort-quiet-canary.

 samir: i'll pin model: `/infra pin-model --service rec-ux --version rwd-model-2026-04-21 --until 25pct`  please leave pin until explicit unpin.

 elaine: starting slowstart: `/ff set rec-ux-v2 --mode slowstart --target 1 --step 3 --interval 420 --reason "v2.23 initial canary"`

 deploy-bot: slowstart active: targets 1 -> 4 -> 7 (progressing). circuit-breaker: auto-disable if error_delta > 1.2% OR p95 +180ms OR gpu_mem > 88%.

 ops-oncall: i'm on watch. muting non-critical alerts. key metrics: error-rate by route, p50/p95/p99, kv cache hit, embedding queue depth.

 release-coordinator: release notes posted: https://confluence.redwood/release/v2.23. runbook link added: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/ff-rollout.

 deploy-bot: slowstart snapshot: 7% -> telemetry: error +0.12%, p95 +15ms, mem 61% -> no triggers. proceeding to 10%.

 samir: small QA note: one internal cohort shows slightly different ranking but not impacting public. filed INC-4208. not blocking.

 elaine: hold at 25% for 45m, then run smoke for 10m. if smoke passes we plan 100% at 03:10 UTC. abort criteria: error_delta >= 0.9% sustained 5m OR p99 +250ms. rollback steps if abort:
1) `/ff set rec-ux-v2 --target 0 --force --reason "auto-rollback"`
2) `/infra rollback-release --id v2.23 --drain 30s`
3) `/infra unpin-model --service rec-ux`

 ops-oncall: quick exec snippet for emergency drain (copy/paste): `curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/flags/rec-ux-v2?action=set&target=0&force=true"`

 deploy-bot: reached 25% -> smoke running now. will report back in 10m.

 elaine: thanks everyone. i'll open the post-deploy thread once we finish or abort. :raised_hands:
